description: M-26-14 Element 1 / Appendix A HWAM: new or rarely-seen device on a network segment (rare host.name per network.segment, 15m buckets). Passive complement to osquery agent inventory — catches unmanaged OT/IoT devices that never run an agent.

detectors.detector_description: Rarely-seen device (host.name) observed on this network segment — potential rogue/unauthorized asset

custom_settings.m_26_14_requirement: Appendix A HWAM | Network Visibility — passive device discovery | Element 1 Asset Coverage
custom_settings.m_26_14_note: Runs over logs-m_26_14_netobserved.devices-* (NetFlow/DHCP/ARP/Suricata observations). rare() scores a host.name that appears infrequently within its network.segment relative to the segment's established population — the statistical signature of a new/rogue device. Complements m_26_14-ml-element1-asset-coverage (managed-agent coverage) with the unmanaged-device view. Baseline: 7 days minimum so each segment's normal device population is learned.
custom_settings.m_26_14_acceptance_criteria: Flags a device that has never (or rarely) appeared on a segment within one 15m bucket of first observation. <=5% FP vs. a stable known-device population.
custom_settings.m_26_14_description: Detects new or rarely-observed devices per network segment from passive network telemetry. Each OT/IoT device on the wire is normalized to a host.name (netdev-<mac>) by the m_26_14-network-device-normalize pipeline; rare() over host.name partitioned by network.segment surfaces devices outside the segment's learned population. Primary Element 1 signal for unmanaged/unauthorized hardware that agent-based osquery HWAM cannot see (PLCs, cameras, sensors). M-26-14 Appendix A HWAM, network visibility, Element 1 asset coverage.
